title: Your seated everyday routine
safetyPrompts: This is an unreviewed production draft, not a session for exercise use.
For a published seated session, use a stable chair without wheels, with feet comfortably supported. For standing content, use stable support and a clear floor.
Move within a comfortable range. Stop if you feel pain, dizziness or unwell; do not continue through symptoms.
If unsure whether an activity is suitable, ask a qualified health professional. This programme does not prescribe activity for a diagnosis.

chapters.title: A moment to begin
chapters.script: Production review of Your seated everyday routine. This draft has not been professionally approved and is not for exercise use. The proposed session begins with a stable chair or wall, a clear space, and a comfortable pace. The reviewer must confirm the movements, alternatives and timing before filming.

chapters.title: Small seated steps
chapters.script: Sit tall, feet resting on the floor. Hold the chair sides. Lift one bent knee a little, lower slowly, then change legs. Make each lift comfortable.
chapters.reviewerNote: Timing is a filming window including instruction, rest and optional repetitions. Reviewer sets dose; do not fill the window with continuous repetitions.

chapters.title: Time to reset
chapters.cue: Rest is part of the session
chapters.script: A rest window follows. The final narrator will invite the viewer to settle, take a comfortable breath, or pause for longer. There is no target to chase.

chapters.title: Ankle movement
chapters.script: Holding the chair, extend one leg comfortably. Point the toes away, then draw them back. Return the foot to the floor before changing sides.
chapters.reviewerNote: Timing is a filming window including instruction, rest and optional repetitions. Reviewer sets dose; do not fill the window with continuous repetitions.

chapters.title: Time to reset
chapters.cue: Rest is part of the session
chapters.script: A rest window follows. The final narrator will invite the viewer to settle, take a comfortable breath, or pause for longer. There is no target to chase.

chapters.title: A comfortable turn
chapters.script: Sit upright with feet grounded. Cross your arms towards your shoulders. Keep the hips facing forward as the upper body turns gently. Return to centre before changing sides.
chapters.reviewerNote: Timing is a filming window including instruction, rest and optional repetitions. Reviewer sets dose; do not fill the window with continuous repetitions.

chapters.title: Time to reset
chapters.cue: Rest is part of the session
chapters.script: A rest window follows. The final narrator will invite the viewer to settle, take a comfortable breath, or pause for longer. There is no target to chase.

chapters.title: Open across the chest
chapters.script: Sit upright. Ease the shoulders back and down. Open the arms to the sides and gently lift the chest, then relax. Avoid forcing the stretch.
chapters.reviewerNote: Timing is a filming window including instruction, rest and optional repetitions. Reviewer sets dose; do not fill the window with continuous repetitions.

chapters.title: A calm finish
chapters.cue: A little time, at your own pace
chapters.script: This is the proposed closing section. The final instructor will guide a comfortable finish and remind the viewer that resting or doing less is welcome. The session remains awaiting professional approval.
